question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

The original inhabitants of a country
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"original"** means something that is the first form or version from which copies can be made. (मूल)

 
 
• **Example: **The original manuscript of the novel was handwritten by the author.
 
 
 
• **"Aborigines" **refers to the original inhabitants of a country. (मूल निवासी)
 
 
• **Example: **The Aborigines of Australia have a rich cultural heritage that dates back thousands of years.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the one-word substitute for **"The original inhabitants of a country"** is **'Aborigines'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Aborigines**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Primitive **(प्राचीन): Relating to an early stage in evolutionary or historical development.

 
 
• **Example:** The tools found at the archaeological site were quite primitive.
 
 
 
• **Citizens **(नागरिक): Legally recognized subjects or nationals of a state or commonwealth.
 
 
• **Example: **As citizens of the country, they have certain rights and responsibilities.
 
 
 
• **Aliens** (विदेशी): Foreigners; especially those who are not naturalized citizens of the country where they are living.
 
 
• **Example:** The new policy affects aliens who have overstayed their visas.
